body:
New per-game social primitives on IDUNA's online-services layer (internal/http/handlers/game_social.go, migration 202609240300_friends_and_duels.sql): public profile read, friend-request send/list/accept/decline, friends list/remove, duel create/list/accept/decline. Friendship derives from accepted friend_requests rows; mutual pending requests auto-accept. Duels require an existing friendship and are V0-scoped to the invite lifecycle (turning an accepted duel into a live match instance is real, named, deferred work). Full lifecycle test (game_social_test.go) against real SQLite migrations, all green; go build/vet/test clean across IDUNA. Commit 70b6b06, pushed. Founder real-time ask: add IDUNA online accounts / social features / profiles / friends / friendly challenges (duels) for DEADWEIGHT / WOTAN -- this closes the IDUNA backend piece; WOTAN pages and DEADWEIGHT client wiring are separate, named follow-up items.

⚓ ☃
title: Friends, profiles, and friendly-challenge duels (S537)
